Container.Name: bookdoe
Container.Overview: Self-hosted library for ebooks and audiobooks. Adopts the files you already have and serves a web Player, OPDS and the iOS and Android apps. Hobby project, best-effort support. Needs an OpenReads container (metadata service) reachable at the OpenReads URL below; the Compose file in the repository runs both. Acquisition features are optional and off by default; you are responsible for lawful use of them. Replace the Repository above with a published image once one exists, or build bookdoe:local from the repository first (see docs/UNRAID.md).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web Player and /manage

Config.Name: OpenReads URL
Config.Description: Address of the OpenReads metadata container

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: External HTTPS URL (the iOS app needs HTTPS for non-local hosts)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the media

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the media
